7 Shi wɔhiɛ nɛkɛ jwetri nɛɛ yɛ su kpuji amli, koni hewalɛ ni fa kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ afee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ni jeee wɔnɔ. 8 Afĩfĩaa wɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔtsui esuuu; wɔfeɔ yaa, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeko wui, 9awaa wɔ yi, shi kɛ̃lɛ akwako wɔ; atswiaa wɔ shi, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔpleneko. 10 Daa nɛɛ wɔhiɛ Yesu gbele lɛ yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli. 11 Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ nɛɛ, daa nɛɛ atu wɔ awo gbele dɛŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ amli. 12No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ gbele tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli, shi nyɛ lɛ, wala tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛmli.
13 Shi akɛni wɔyɔɔ nakai hemɔkɛyeli mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Mihe miye hewɔ ni miwie” lɛ, wɔ hu wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔwieɔ; 14 ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ mɔ ni tee Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shi lɛ, eeetee wɔ kɛ Yesu shi, ni ekɛ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaadamɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ. 15Ejaakɛ nyɛhewɔ afeɔ fɛɛ, koni dromɔ ni fa babaoo lɛ atsɔ̃ mɛi pii ashidaa nɔ atɛke nɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnyamwoo.
Wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa
16No hewɔ ni wɔtsui efãaa lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ wɔkponɔgbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ fiteɔ kwraa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔmli gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee gbi fɛɛ gbi. 17Ejaakɛ wɔmanehulu ni jaraaa ni asaŋ esɛɛ etsɛɛɛ nɛɛ, baahã wɔna naanɔ anunyam kpele ni jara wa aahu; 18ejaakɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni kwɛɔ nii ni anaa lɛ, shi moŋ nii ni anaaa lɛ wɔkwɛɔ; ejaakɛ nii ni anaa lɛ hiɔ shi be fioo kɛkɛ, shi nii ni anaaa lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyashiɔ naanɔ.

english_text:
1 Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever. 2While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home. 3We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
4These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die. 5God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it. 6So always be cheerful!
As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord. 7But we live by faith, not by what we see. 8We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord. 9But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him. 10 After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies.
Bringing People to God
11We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are. 12We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
13If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good. 14We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died. 15And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
16We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way. 17Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new. 18God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
19What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace. 20We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God. 21Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_text:
Wɔshweɔ wɔŋwɛi gbɔmɔtso hee kɛ ŋwɛi shĩa hee lɛ
1 Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ, kɛ akumɔ wɔbuu ni wɔyɔɔ mli ni ji wɔshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ shĩa jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ tsu ko ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, shĩa ko ni jeee niji akɛfee, ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ yɛ ŋwɛi. 2 Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi tete yɛ wɔbuu nɛɛ mli, ni wɔshweɔ akɛ akɛ wɔtsu ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ awo wɔ, 3ni kɛ akɛwo wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ anaŋ wɔ akɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ yayai. 4 Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ buu lɛ mli lɛ hu, akɛni wɔhe jaraa wɔ hewɔ lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔŋtsɔi, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ ajie wɔhenii, shi moŋ wɔsumɔɔ akɛ awo wɔ nii ashwie nɔ, koni wala lɛ ami nɔ ni gboɔ lɛ. 5 Shi mɔ ni saa wɔ hã enɛ nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni hã wɔ Mumɔ lɛ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ lɛ.
6 No hewɔ lɛ, wɔyɛ tsui daa, ni wɔle akɛ gbii abɔ ni wɔyɔɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli nɛɛ wɔdom kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; 7 ejaakɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ, shi jeee ninamɔ naa, 8 shi wɔyɛ tsui, ni esa wɔhiɛ moŋ akɛ wɔɔdom kɛjɛ gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ mli, ni wɔyahi shĩa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ, shĩa wɔyɔɔ jio, dommɔ wɔdom jio, esa ni wɔsa ehiɛ. 10 Ejaakɛ ja wɔ fɛɛ wɔpue faŋŋ yɛ Kristo kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana nii ni efee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwobɔɔ ni efee lɛ, ekpakpa jio, efɔŋ jio.
Kristo ekpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
11No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔle Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ nyɛhenilee mli hu. 12 Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe yi wɔjieɔ wɔhãa nyɛ ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ wɔkɛmiihã nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛkɛshwã nyɛfɔ̃ wɔnɔ, koni nyɛna eko nyɛkɛɛ mɛi ni shwãa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ shi jeee yɛ tsui mli lɛ. 13Ejaakɛ kɛ sɛkɛ wɔyeɔ jiŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ wɔyeɔ, ni kɛ wɔyɛ shishiishi hu jiŋŋ, nyɛ hewɔ ni. 14Ejaakɛ Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ nyɛɔ wɔnɔ, ni wɔkojoɔ nɛkɛ akɛ, kɛ mɔ kome gbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele lɛ, belɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ egboi. 15 Ni egbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele, koni mɛi ni hiɛ kãmɔ lɛ ahiɛ akakãmɔ miihã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛhiɛ akãmɔ ahã mɔ ni gbo ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ ahã amɛ lɛ.
16Belɛ, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, wɔleee mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa; ni kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa wɔle Kristo yɛ tete lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ wɔleee lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ. 17 Hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, bɔɔnɔ hee ji lɛ; blema nii lɛ eho; naa, nibii fɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ ehee. 18Shi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ekɛ wɔ kpãtã, ni ekɛ kpãtãmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ hã wɔ lɛ dɛŋ; 19no ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ ekɛ je lɛ kpãtã, ni ebuuu amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ ehãaa amɛ, ni etu kpãtãmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ.
20No hewɔ lɛ, wɔji bɔfoi yɛ Kristo najiaŋ, tamɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ wɔnɔ eewie eetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi: wɔdamɔ Kristo najiaŋ wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ, nyɛhãa akpãtã nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ! 21Ejaakɛ mɔ ni leee esha lɛ, wɔhewɔ lɛ ehã etsɔ̃ esha, koni wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ yɛ emli.

english_text:
1We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace. 2 In the Scriptures God says,
“When the time came,
I listened to you,
and when you needed help,
I came to save you.”
That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
3We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems. 4But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times. 5 We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food. 6But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real. 7We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
8Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not. 9We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed, 10and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
11Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you. 12We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us. 13I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us.
The Temple of the Living God
14Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same? 15Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't? 16 Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says,
“I will live with these people
and walk among them.
I will be their God,
and they will be
my people.”
17 The Lord also says,
“Leave them and stay away!
Don't touch anything
that isn't clean.
Then I will welcome you
18 and be your Father.
You will be my sons
and my daughters,
as surely as I am God,
the All-Powerful.”
translation_text:
Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi anitsumɔ walɛ kɛ enyam
1 Shi akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi ji wɔ yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkahã Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ fee yaka. 2 Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Be ni sa mli mibo bo toi yɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ.” Naa, be ni sa jogbaŋŋ nɛ; naa, yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɛ.
3Ni wɔtooo mɔ ko mɔ ko pampi yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, koni akagbe wɔsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he guɔ. 4Shi moŋ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji wɔ. Wɔmĩaa wɔhiɛ babaoo. Wɔtoɔ wɔtsui shi yɛ amanehului kɛ fimɔi kɛ jaramɔi amli. 5 Ayiɔ wɔ ni awoɔ wɔ tsuŋ kpitiokpitio. Afeɔ wɔ soisoi. Wɔtsuɔ nii kɛ kpeshii kɛ deŋmegbomɔ pii. Wɔhiɔ ŋmãa, 6 ni wɔbɔɔ hetsemɔ he mɔdɛŋ kɛ nilee. Wɔŋmɛɔ wɔtsui shi; wɔmli hi. Yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ naa lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ osato bɛ mli. 7 Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ wɔwieɔ anɔkwale. Ni wɔwoɔ jalɛ tawuunii yɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ. 8Mɛi komɛi woɔ wɔhiɛ nyam; ni mɛi komɛi gbeɔ wɔhe guɔ. Mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe efɔŋ, ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe ekpakpa. Anaa wɔ akɛ shishiulɔi, kɛ̃lɛ, anɔkwafoi ji wɔ. 9 Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni aleee kɛ mɛi ni ale krɛdɛɛ; tamɔ mɛi ni gboiɔ, ni naa, wɔhiɛ kãmɔ. Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni agbalaa amɛtoi, ni kɛ̃lɛ agbeko wɔ. 10 Wɔ tamɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi, shi wɔmii shɛɔ daa. Wɔ tamɔ ohiafoi, shi wɔfeɔ mɛi pii niiatsɛmɛi, ni wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko, ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔyɛ nii fiaa.
Nyɛgbelea nyɛtsui naa nyɛhãa wɔ
11Korintobii, wɔkɛ nyɛ ewie faŋŋ; wɔtsui mli egbele. 12Gbɛ yɛ wɔmli hã nyɛ, shi nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛtsuii amli joɔ. 13 Nyɛ hu nyɛgbelea nyɛtsuii amli nakai nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛto wɔ najiaŋ. Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ mibii.
Kristojamɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ
14 Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ akagbalaa kɔŋtso kome, akɛni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeee hegbɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ jalɛ kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ yeli la kɛ duŋ yɔɔ? 15Ni mɛɛ gbeekpãmɔ Kristo kɛ Belial yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ nijaa mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ kɛ mɔ ni heee yeee yɔɔ? 16 Ni asaŋ mɛɛ ekomefeemɔ yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu kɛ amãgãi ateŋ? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ,
“Mahi amɛmli, ni manyiɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.”
17 No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ,
“Nyɛjea amɛteŋ, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe,
ni nyɛkataa muji nɔ ko he,
ni mahere nyɛ atuu.
18 Ni matsɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ,
ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ mibihii kɛ mibiyei,” Yehowa, Ofe lɛ, kɛɛ.

english_text:
1My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him.
The Church Makes Paul Happy
2Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone. 3I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die. 4I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
5 After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears. 6But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us. 7Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
8I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while. 9Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us. 10When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
11Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter. 12When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us. 13And we were greatly encouraged.
Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about. 14We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true. 15Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him. 16It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_text:
1Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni asumɔɔ, akɛni wɔna nɛkɛ shiwoi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua wɔhe kɛjɛa heloo kɛ mumɔ muji fɛɛ mli, ni wɔhã wɔhetsemɔ aye emuu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Paulo mii shɛ ehe akɛ asafo lɛ eshwa ehe
2 Nyɛhãa wɔ gbɛ yɛ nyɛmli! Wɔfeko mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ ko; wɔyeko mɔ ko awui, wɔyeko mɔ ko amim. 3 Mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛbu nyɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ mikɛɛ momo akɛ wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ yɛ wɔtsui mli bɔ ni gbele mli oo, wala mli oo, wɔkɛ nyɛ ekome. 4Mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni asaŋ mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ babaoo; miyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛjemɔ, miyi kɛtɛke nɔ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ wɔmanehulu lɛ fɛɛ mli.
5 Ejaakɛ shi be ni wɔba Makedonia lɛ hu, wɔnaaa wɔgbɔmɔtso hejɔlɛ kwraa; shi moŋ he fɛɛ he lɛ amanehulu sɔŋŋ wɔnaa: wɔkponɔgbɛ lɛ nɔmɔi, wɔmligbɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔi. 6 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni shɛjeɔ mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ amii lɛ, kɛ Tito baa lɛ shɛje wɔmii; 7shi jeee ebaa lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ miishɛjemɔ ni nyɛkɛshɛje emii lɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba wɔ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ mi lɛ kɛ nyɛheshwamɔ lɛ kɛ mihe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ; enɛ hã mina miishɛɛ babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ.
8 Ejaakɛ kɛ wolo ni miŋma nyɛ lɛ edɔ nyɛ lɛ, mishwaaa mihe; kɛji mishwa mihe po lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ nakai wolo lɛ edɔ nyɛ, kɛ be kuku po, 9agbɛnɛ mimii eshɛ; jeee dɔ ni edɔ nyɛ lɛ hewɔ ni, shi moŋ akɛni dɔlɛ lɛ hã nyɛshwa nyɛhe lɛ hewɔ ni; ejaakɛ edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akajɛ wɔ ni nɔ ko bɔ nyɛ. 10 Ejaakɛ dɔlɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɛɔ tsuitsakemɔ kɛbaa, tsuitsakemɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa yiwalaheremɔ ni ashwaaa he yɛ he lɛ mli; shi je nɛɛ mli dɔlɛ lɛ tsɛɔ gbele. 11Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ dɔlɛ ni edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, nɔ naajiemɔ, nɔ mlifu, nɔ gbeyeishemɔ, nɔ shwee, nɔ hiɛdɔɔ, nɔ jalɛ kojomɔ ni etsɛ ewo nyɛmli! Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɛhe tse yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
12No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miŋma nyɛ tete lɛ, jeee mɔ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, asaŋ hu jeee mɔ ni atɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ apue faŋŋ ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 13Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔmii eshɛ. Shi miishɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ Tito miishɛɛ lɛ he lɛ hã wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ babaoo, ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhã etsui enyɔ emli, 14ejaakɛ kɛ mishwã nyɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ko mli lɛ, nyɛwooo mi hiɛgbele; shi tamɔ bɔ ni wɔwie nibii fɛɛ anɔkwale mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔshwãa hu ni wɔshwã wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Tito lɛ efee anɔkwale, 15 ni eyɛ nyɛhe tsui babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ, ejaakɛ ekaiɔ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ here lɛ lɛ. 16Mina miishɛɛ akɛ mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.

english_text:
Generous Giving
1 My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace. 2Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously. 3They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to. 4They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people. 5And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
6Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun. 7You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
8I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown. 9You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
10A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice. 11I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving. 12It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
13I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair 14for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share, 15 just as the Scriptures say,
“Those who gathered
too much
had nothing left.
Those who gathered
only a little
had all they needed.”
Titus and His Friends
16I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do. 17When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you. 18With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news. 19The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help. 20We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift. 21 But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
22We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much. 23Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ. 24Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_text:
Kristofoi atooyeli
1 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiihã nyɛle dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro Makedonia asafoi lɛ, 2akɛ aka amɛ yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ, ni amɛhĩa katekate lɛ mli po, amɛ jie mlihilɛ falɛ kpo; 3ejaakɛ miiye odase akɛ amɛhã bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ, ni amɛhã fe bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ tete yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, 4 ni amɛkɛ tutɔmɔ babaoo kpa wɔ fai ni ahã amɛ hu amɛna naanyobɔɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ mli gbɛ, 5ni jeee bɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛŋɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛhã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu kɛ wɔ hu, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa. 6No hã wɔkpa Tito fai, koni bɔ ni ebɔ̃i momo sa lɛ, nakai etsu dromɔ nitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛgbe naa hu yɛ nyɛteŋ. 7 Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtɛkeɔ nɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛ wɔmli ni eyɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkwɛa koni nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ mli hu lɛ nyɛtɛke nɔ.
8Miwieee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ mɛi krokomɛi amɔdɛŋbɔɔ mikɛkaa nyɛ hu nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ makwɛ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋŋ lo. 9 Ejaakɛ nyɛle wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ ni ji niiatsɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ohiafo yɛ nyɛhewɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ ehia lɛ nɔ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi.
10Nɔ ni mijwɛŋ yɛ sane nɛɛ he nɛ, enɛ hi hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni akɛbaafee lɛ hu nyɛ tsutsu nyɛje shishi afi beebe nɛ. 11No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛgbea feemɔ lɛ naa, koni bɔ ni oya nɔŋŋ ni nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛjɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbea naa. 12 Ejaakɛ kɛ tsui yɛ he lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko hãa kɛjɛɔ nɔ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; jeee kɛjɛ nɔ ni ebɛ mli. 13Ejaakɛ mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mɛi komɛi ahe ajɔ amɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhao, shi moŋ koni fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ; 14 nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ ayaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ mɛi komɛi nyɛɛɛ ahã lɛ najiaŋ, koni be kroko lɛ nɔ ni amɛ hu amɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ abaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛhã lɛ najiaŋ, koni aye hegbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; 15 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Mɔ ni bua pii naa lɛ, enaa eko yɛ sɛɛ,
ni mɔ ni bua fioo naa hu lɛ, eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko.”
16Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛhedɔɔ nɛɛ wo Tito tsui mli lɛ; 17ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ wɔkɛŋmɛ ehiɛ ni eba ni ekpɛlɛ̃, shi akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ he tsui waa hewɔ lɛ, eba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa. 18Shi nyɛmi ni wɔtsu wɔfata ehe nɛɛ yɛ yijiemɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ; 19 shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi asafoi lɛ hala lɛ hu, ni ekɛ wɔ anyiɛ ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nitsumɔ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ anunyam, ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he tsui ni wɔyɔɔ; 20ejaakɛ wɔmiikwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni mɔ ko akawie wɔhe efɔŋ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa nikee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ hewɔ; 21 ejaakɛ oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ efee fɛo, jeee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
22Shi wɔtsu wɔnyɛmi lɛ hu wɔfata amɛhe, mɔ ni wɔka lɛ kpitiokpitio yɛ nibii pii amli, ni wɔna akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, shi agbɛnɛ eebɔ mɔdɛŋ po fe tsutsu lɛ, yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ pii lɛ hewɔ. 23 Shi Tito lɛ, mihefatalɔ ni mikɛtsuɔ nyɛhe nii ji lɛ, ni wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu, asafoi lɛ abɔfoi kɛ Kristo hiɛnyam ji amɛ. 24 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛsuɔmɔ kɛ shwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ kpo nyɛtsɔa amɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛ.

english_text:
The Money for God's People
1I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people. 2I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give. 3This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
4Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more. 5So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
6Remember this saying,
“A few seeds make
a small harvest,
but a lot of seeds make
a big harvest.”
7 Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give. 8God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others. 9 The Scriptures say,
“God freely gives his gifts
to the poor,
and always does right.”
10 God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need. 11You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
12What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God. 13The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else. 14Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much. 15Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_text:
Nihãmɔ mli jɔɔmɔ
1 Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛyaasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɔ ko. 2 Ejaakɛ mile bɔ ni nyɛna he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ Makedoniabii lɛ akɛ Akaiabii esaa amɛhe amɛto kɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛ afi lɛ beebe; ni nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ ewo mɛi pii ahiɛdɔɔ. 3 Shi mitsu nyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni wɔshwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ akafee yaka yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛhe bɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ; 4ni kɛ Makedoniabii lɛ kɛ mi ba lɛ, amɛkabanina nyɛ akɛ nyɛsako nyɛhe, ni wɔhiɛ, misumɔɔɔ akɛ makɛɛ akɛ nyɛ nyɛhiɛ bagboi yɛ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ mli. 5No hewɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ makpa nyɛmimɛi lɛ afai ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ ni amɛbasaa nɛkɛ nyɛjɔɔmɔ ni awo shi momo nɛɛ amɛto koni efee klalo akɛ jɔɔmɔ nɔ ko shi jeee nɔ ko ni akɛ hiɛjoomɔ miishɔ̃ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
6 Shi enɛ mikɛɔ akɛ, mɔ ni lɛteɔ nii ahe duɔ lɛ, ekɛ helɛtemɔ hu aaakpa; ni mɔ ni duɔ yɛ jɔɔmɔ mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mli nɔŋŋ eeekpa yɛ. 7 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni ekpɛ mli momo yɛ etsui mli, ni ekajɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli loo nɔnyɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tsuijurɔnaa halɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ. 8Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ akɛ eeehã dromɔ fɛɛ atɛke nɔ ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛhe atua nyɛ kwraa yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli daa nɛɛ ni nyɛna nii kɛtɛke nɔ hã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa; 9 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Egbɛɔ eshwãa ehãa ohiafoi lɛ;
ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.”
10 Shi mɔ ni kɛ dumɔwui keɔ dulɔ ni ekɛ aboloo hu hãa yeli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ dumɔwui ni afa, ni eeehã nyɛjalɛ yibii lɛ hu ashwere; 11 ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni nyɛfee mlihilɔi kwraa, ni nyɛmlihilɛ lɛ ahã atsɔ wɔnɔ akɛ shidaa aha Nyɔŋmɔ; 12 ejaakɛ nɛkɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nɛɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee fɛnemɔ kɛkɛ efɛneɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ yɛ fimɔ mli, shi moŋ ehãa adaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi babaoo kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ hu. 13Ejaakɛ odase kpakpa ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yeɔ lɛ hãa amɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ ye ni nyɛyeɔ Kristo Sanekpakpa ni nyɛjajeɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ mlihilɛ ni nyɛkɛyeɔ nyɛbuaa amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ, 14ni amɛbaasɔle amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛbaashwe nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛnɔ kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ. 15Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ enikeenii ni anyɛŋ agba lɛ hewɔ!

english_text:
Paul Defends His Work for Christ
1Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle. 2Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way. 3We live in this world, but we don't act like its people 4or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments 5and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ. 6And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
7You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do. 8Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag. 9And I am not trying to scare you with my letters. 10Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.” 11Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
12We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves. 13We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work. 14We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
15We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal. 16Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done. 17 The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.” 18You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_text:
Paulo miifã ebɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ he
1 Shi mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ Kristo hejɔlɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, mi ni akɛɛ kɛ miyɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ mifeɔ mihe humi yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi kɛ mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mijeɔ ekãa miwoɔ nyɛ lɛ. 2 Shi miikpa nyɛ fai ni kɛ miba lɛ, nyɛkahã mikɛ hewalɛ ni mito akɛ mikɛbaawie lɛ miijie ekãa kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni susuɔ akɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo naa lɛ. 3Eyɛ mli akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ moŋ, shi wɔwuuu ta yɛ heloo naa. 4 Ejaakɛ wɔtawuunii lɛ jeee heloo mli nii ni, shi moŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, hewalɛnii ni akɛkumɔɔ mɔji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni, 5ni wɔkumɔɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ he nɔ ni awoɔ ashiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ, ni wɔŋɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ nom ni ebo Kristo toi, 6ni wɔsaa wɔhe wɔto koni, kɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ ye emuu lɛ, wɔgbala toigbele fɛɛ he toi.
7Nyɛkwɛa nibii bɔ ni nyɛnaa amɛ lɛ. Kɛ mɔ ko heɔ yeɔ akɛ Kristo nɔ ji lɛ lɛ, esusu he ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eji Kristo nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔji Kristo nii. 8 Ejaakɛ kɛ shwãa po mashwã kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ wɔhegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã wɔ ni wɔkɛhã nyɛnane amɔ shi ni jeee akɛ wɔkɛbutu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ gboŋ, 9koni mikafee akɛ mɔ ko ni woɔ nyɛhe gbeyei kɛ woji. 10 Ejaakɛ akɛɔ akɛ, woji lɛ amli saji tsii ni amɛmli wa moŋ, shi kɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɛ biɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe waaa ni ewiemɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. 11 Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ana ale enɛ akɛ, bɔ ni wɔwiemɔ yɔɔ yɛ woji amli kɛ wɔbɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kɛ wɔyɛ jɛi lɛ wɔnifeemɔnii hu yɔɔ.
12 Ejaakɛ wɔkaaa akɛ wɔɔbu wɔhe wɔshi mɛi komɛi ni jieɔ amɛhe yi lɛ anɔ, aloo akɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe aaato amɛhe. Amɛ lɛ, akɛni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe susuɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe toɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛyooo sɛɛ. 13 Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔshwãŋ fe nine, shi moŋ wɔshwãa yɛ susumɔ kpãa ni Nyɔŋmɔ esusu ehã wɔ ni kɛlɛ shɛɔ nyɛ hu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ naa. 14Ejaakɛ wɔkpãaa wɔmli tsɔ tamɔ mɛi ni shɛɛɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ klɛŋklɛŋ wɔkɛ Kristo he Sanekpakpa lɛ shɛ nyɛŋɔɔ; 15 wɔshwãaa fe nine yɛ mɛi krokomɛi anitsumɔi ahewɔ; shi wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ shwere lɛ, wɔnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli baagbele kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ wɔsusumɔ kpãa lɛ naa, 16koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ niiaŋ, ni wɔkashwã wɔfɔ̃ nii ni atsu momo yɛ mɔ kroko nɔ mli lɛ anɔ.
17 Shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ eshwã efɔ̃! 18 Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni jieɔ ehe yi lɛ ji mɔ ni sa, shi moŋ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jieɔ eyi lɛ.

english_text:
Paul and the False Apostles
1Please put up with a little of my foolishness. 2I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ. 3 But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way. 4We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message. 5I think I am as good as any of those super apostles. 6I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
7Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge? 8I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you. 9 Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden. 10As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this. 11And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
12I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing. 13Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ. 14And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light. 15So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve.
Paul's Sufferings for Christ
16I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little. 17When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord. 18Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I. 19And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool. 20In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face. 21I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way.
If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do. 22Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I. 23 Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
24 Five times my own people gave me 39 lashes with a whip. 25 Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea. 26 During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
27I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm. 28Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches. 29When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
30If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am. 31God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever! 32 The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me. 33But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_text:
Eba lɛ akɛ Paulo ajie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yi
1Mina ni kulɛ nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mikwashiafeemɔ fioo! Shi anɔkwale nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mi. 2 Ejaakɛ nyɛhe awuŋã ni miyeɔ lɛ, miiye lɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye; ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛhe baa mihã nuu kome ni mikɛ oblayoo foro ni he tse ayahã Kristo. 3 Shi miishe gbeyei akɛ aleenɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni onufu lɛ kɛ ekutumpɔo lɛ laka Hawa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafite nyɛ hu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni nyɛŋmɛɛ suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ Kristo lɛ he. 4 Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebashiɛ Yesu kroko ni wɔshiɛko, loo mumɔ kroko ni nyɛnako, loo Sanekpakpa kroko ni nyɛmɔko mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhere lɛ jogbaŋŋ. 5 Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ. 6 Shi kɛ mi ji gbɔmɔ ko ni leee nɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ gbɛfaŋ tete lɛ, mijeee nakai yɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ; shi moŋ wɔfee enɛ faŋŋ wɔhã nyɛ, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ, yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
7 Aloo belɛ akɛ miba mihe shi koni awo nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yaka lɛ mifee esha? 8 Mitswa asafoi krokomɛi ojo mihe nyɔmɔwoo yɛ amɛdɛŋ mikɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɛ. 9 Ni be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ ni efi mi tete lɛ, mifeee jatsu mihãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko, ejaakɛ nii ni hia mi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ hã shɛ midɛŋ, ni mile mihenɔkwɛmɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni masaa male mihenɔkwɛmɔ, koni mikatsɔ̃ jatsu mihã nyɛ. 10 Gbii abɔ ni Kristo anɔkwale lɛ yɔɔ mimli nɛɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ mishwãa nɛɛ gbɛ yɛ Akaia niiaŋ. 11Mɛɛ hewɔŋ? Akɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ hewɔŋ? Nyɔŋmɔ le.
12Nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ, mafee, koni mikɛtsi mɛi ni taoɔ mihe sane lɛ agbɛ, ni ana amɛ yɛ amɛshwãanii lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni anaa wɔ hu lɛ. 13 Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ ji amale bɔfoi, nitsulɔi shishiulɔi ni tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ Kristo bɔfoi. 14Ni enɛ bɛ naakpɛɛ tete ejaakɛ Satan diɛŋtsɛ tsakeɔ ehe etsɔ̃ɔ la bɔfo; 15no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ tamɔ jalɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko wulu ko; amɛnaagbee baafee tamɔ bɔ ni amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
16 Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko akabu mi kwashia, shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, belɛ nyɛŋɔa mi akɛ kwashia kɛkɛ mɔ, koni mi hu mawo shwãa fioo ko. 17Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, miwieee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baawie, shi moŋ tamɔ kwashia wieɔ, yɛ nɔmimaa ni miyɔɔ akɛ miyɛ shwãa nɔ lɛ hewɔ. 18Akɛni mɛi pii shwãa yɛ heloo naa hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mashwã eko. 19Akɛni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ toɔ nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ; 20ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko miiye nyɛ nyɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ko miitswa nyɛ ojo, kɛ mɔ ko miimɔ nyɛ, kɛ mɔ ko miiwó ehe nɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ, kɛ mɔ ko miigbala nyɛhiɛ ma lɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɔ lɛ. 21Miiwie kɛ hiɛgbele akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni wɔfee gbedee tsɔ̃. Shi nɔ mli ni mɔ ko feɔ ekãa yɛ lɛ, miiwie tamɔ kwashia, mi hu mifeɔ ekãa yɛ mli. 22 Hebribii ji amɛ? Mi hu eko ji mi. Israelbii ni? Mi hu eko ji mi. Abraham shwiei ni? Mi hu eko ji mi. 23 Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ? Miiwie tamɔ mɔ ni yitsoŋ kãa lɛ. Mife amɛ yɛ tɔlɛ nitsumɔi ni tɛke nɔ amli, yɛ tsuŋwoi babaoi amli, yɛ yii ni fa tsɔ̃ amli, yɛ gbelei amli kpitiokpitio. 24 Yudafoi yi mi shii enumɔ, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ, shwɛ ekome ni afee kpãi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. 25 Atswia mi kpãi shii etɛ̃, atswia mi tɛi shi kome, mikɛ lɛlɛ sha shi shii etɛ̃. Miye jenamɔ kɛ jetsɛremɔ yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli. 26Mifã gbɛ kpitiokpitio kɛ emli osharãi yɛ fai ahiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ ojotswalɔi adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ mijakubii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ maŋ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋa nɔ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ nyɛmimɛi shiwodudui lɛ ateŋ. 27 Mitsu nii kɛ tɔlɛ, yɛ kpeshii amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai mli, yɛ ŋmaahilɛi amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ fɛ̃i kɛ yayainyiɛmɔ mli. 28 Nibii ni yɔɔ sɛɛ ayakã; shi nɔ ni haoɔ mi daa gbi ji asafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahe susumɔ. 29 Namɔ gbedeɔ, ni mi lɛ migbedeee? Namɔ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ, ni mimli eshãaa mi?
30 Kɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ mashwã kɛ̃lɛ, mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedemɔnii anɔ. 31 Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ, le akɛ mimaleee. 32Yɛ Damasko lɛ, lumɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ Areta shishi lɛ hã bulɔi bu Damaskobii amaŋ lɛ he ni amɔ mi, 33 ni ashiu mi yɛ kafu mli kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ mli kɛyi shi, ni mijo foi yɛ edɛŋ.

english_text:
Visions from the Lord
1I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me. 2I know about one of Christ's followers who was taken up into the third heaven 14 years ago. I don't know if the man was still in his body when it happened, but God certainly knows.
3As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time. 4But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell. 5I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
6Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say. 7Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
8Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away. 9But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am. 10Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong.
Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
11I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles. 12When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle. 13You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
14I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children. 15So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much? 16You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you. 17Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you? 18I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
19Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
20I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob. 21I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_text:
Nii ni ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Paulo
1Shwãa he ehĩa moŋ, shi ehĩii hãaa mi, kɛ̃lɛ mibawie ninai kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpojiemɔi ahe. 2Mile gbɔmɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli. Afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ nɛ lɛ, ashá nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ; ashá lɛ ni eyɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; ebɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le. 3Ni mile nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ akɛ ashá lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, jeee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le. 4Shi akɛ asha lɛ kɛtee Paradeiso ni eyanu wiemɔi ni anyɛŋ awie, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsĩɔ tã lɛ, no lɛ mile. 5 Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hewɔ mashwã, shi mishwãŋ mihãŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, akɛ ja yɛ migbedemɔi lɛ ahe. 6 Ejaakɛ kɛji miitao mashwã lɛ, mifeŋ kwashia, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mawie; shi mikuɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ɔ nɔ, koni mɔ ko akabu mi fe bɔ ni enaa mi aloo enuɔ yɛ minaa lɛ.
7 Shi bɔ ni afee ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu ko yɛ kpojiemɔi lɛ adaramɔ ni amɛdara kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahã mi ŋmei ko yɛ miheloo mli, ni ji Satan bɔfo, koni egbala mi mai, ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu. 8Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ koni eje minɔ; 9ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Miduromɔ lɛ fa hã bo, ejaakɛ mihewalɛ lɛ, gbedeefeemɔ mli eyeɔ emuu yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ titri akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedeefeemɔi lɛ anɔ moŋ, koni Kristo hewalɛ lɛ abu mihe. 10 No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ, mimii shɛɔ yɛ gbedeefeemɔi amli, yɛ hiɛnaanɔniinamɔi amli, yɛ fimɔ̃i amli, yɛ yiwaa mli, yɛ jaramɔ mli; ejaakɛ kɛ mifee gbedee lɛ, no minaa hewalɛ.
Paulo wie asafo lɛ hiɛ
11 Mifee kwashia; nyɛ nyɛnyɛ minɔ ni mifee nakai. Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛ moŋ nyɛjieɔ miyi; ejaakɛ kɛji mijeee nɔ ko tete po, eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ. 12 Okadii ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ mli, yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi amli. 13 Ejaakɛ mɛni mli nyɛkpeɔ sɛɛ yɛ fe asafoi krokomɛi lɛ, fe akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ? Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ tɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ afaa mi!
Paulo fã ehe
14 Naa, enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni misaa mihe akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, shi mikɛ mihe ebafɔŋ nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ jeee nyɛnii lɛ mitaoɔ, shi moŋ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ bii tiaa nii toɔ amɛfɔlɔi, shi moŋ fɔlɔi ni tiaa nii toɔ amɛbii. 15 Shi masumɔ babaoo akɛ mafite nii ni miyɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni asaŋ mikɛ mihe ashã afɔle yɛ nyɛsusumai ahewɔ. Ani esa akɛ bɔ ni suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ faa lɛ, nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ lo?
16Nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ nɛ; shi akɛni ŋaalɔ ji mi hewɔ lɛ, mimɔ nyɛ yɛ ŋaa mli. 17Ani mitsɔ̃ mɛi ni mitsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ eko nɔ miye nyɛ amim lo? 18 Mikpa Tito fai ni mitsu lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi ko; ani Tito baye nyɛ amim ko? Ani jeee nakai mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔkɛnyiɛ? Jeee nakai najiamaamɔhei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ wɔnyiɛ?
Kɔkɔbɔɔ
19Asaŋ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnaa sɔŋŋ wɔjieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ lo? Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔwieɔ yɛ, yɛ Kristo mli; shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnaneshimɔmɔ hewɔ wɔwieɔ. 20 Ejaakɛ miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ kɛ miba lɛ, mibanaŋ nyɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛnaŋ mi bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, pɛsɛŋkuminya, oshekuyeli, mɔhewiemɔ, hefaa, sakasakafeemɔ; 21 ni misaa miishe gbeyei akɛ kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaba mi shi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ mahã mɛi ni efee esha sa ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, yɛ amɛmujinii kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ.

english_text:
Final Warnings and Greetings
1 I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.” 2During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning. 3This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful! 4Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
5Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed. 6I hope you will discover we have not failed. 7We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
8All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it. 9Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better. 10I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
11Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other.
Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you. 12Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
13I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_text:
Naagbee kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ ŋaawoo
1 Nyɛŋɔɔ ni mibaa nɛɛ ji nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃. Odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ adaaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi. 2Mɛi ni efee esha sa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ mito momo, ni asaŋ miikɛɛ amɛ mato be mli ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ akɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ lɛ, kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ, 3ejaakɛ nyɛmiitao naakpɛɛ okadi ko ni nyɛkɛaana akɛ Kristo wieɔ yɛ mimli, Kristo mɔ ni gbedeee yɛ nyɛmli, shi moŋ ehe waa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ. 4 Ejaakɛ asɛŋ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, ehiɛ kã; ni wɔ hu wɔgbedeɔ yɛ emli; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakãmɔ ahã nyɛ.
5 Nyɛkaa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lo? Nyɛtaoa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmli nyɛkwɛa. Aloo nyɛleee yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe akɛ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛmli? Kɛ nyɛleee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni esaaa kwraa ji nyɛ. 6Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale akɛ wɔ lɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni esaaa. 7Shi miikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, koni nyɛkafee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko kwraa, jeee koni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni sa hewɔŋ, shi moŋ koni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa, ni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni esaaa. 8Ejaakɛ wɔnyɛŋ nɔ ko wɔfee wɔshi anɔkwale lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ nɔ ko wɔɔfee lɛ, wɔɔfee wɔhã anɔkwale lɛ. 9Ejaakɛ wɔnaa miishɛɛ kɛ wɔfee gbedee ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛyɛ hewalɛ lɛ; shi nɔ he fai ni wɔkpaa ji nyɛ emuuyeli. 10 No hewɔ hu ni miŋmaa enɛ be ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ, koni kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mikɛ nyɛ akaye waa, yɛ hegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã mi ni mikɛsaa shi jeee ni mikɛfite lɛ naa.
11 Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛyea emuu, nyɛshɛjea nyɛhe mii, nyɛjwɛŋmɔ afea ekome, nyɛhĩa shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
12 Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
13Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ Kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen.

english_text:
1-2From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me.
I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work.
To the churches in Galatia:
3I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! 4Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world. 5God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen.
The Only True Message
6I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message, 7when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ. 8I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven. 9I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
10I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ.
How Paul Became an Apostle
11My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach. 12It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
13 You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it. 14 I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us. 15 But even before I was born, God had chosen me by his gift of undeserved grace and had decided 16to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone. 17I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
18 Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for 15 days. 19The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother. 20And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
21Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia. 22But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person. 23They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy. 24And because of me, they praised God.
translation_text:
Ŋamɔ
1 Mi Paulo ni mi ji bɔfo ni mibɔfonitsumɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ, ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko nɔ hu etsɔ̃, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ lɛ, 2kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Galatia asafoi lɛ.
3 Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ ahã nyɛ; 4 Yesu Kristo ni kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ, koni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ jeŋ fɔ̃ŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ. 5Enɔ ji anunyam lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Sanekpakpa kroko bɛ
6Efee mihiɛ yaa akɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛmiitsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ yɛ Kristo dromɔ mli lɛ he kɛya Sanekpakpa kroko he; 7shi jeee Sanekpakpa kroko ni, fe akɛ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ ni hãa nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futuɔ, ni amɛtaoɔ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi. 8Shi kɛji wɔ po aloo bɔfo ni jɛ ŋwɛi tete bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nɔ ni wɔjaje wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu! 9Tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ momo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛmɔ mli nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!” 10 Ejaakɛ be nɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahiɛ gbɛ mitaoɔ loo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ gbɛ? Aloo miitao gbɔmɛi ahiɛ masa? Ejaakɛ kɛ mikã he miitao masa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, jeee Kristo tsulɔ ji mi.
Bɔ ni fee ni Paulo tsɔ̃ bɔfo
11Shi miihã nyɛle, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ Sanekpakpa ni mijaje lɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; 12ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ ko dɛŋ mina kɛjɛ, ni jeee tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hu atsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ naa mina yɛ. 13 Ejaakɛ nyɛnu misa jeŋba lɛ he yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli. Bɔ ni miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi fe nine ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ makpãtã ehiɛ; 14ni mitee hiɛ yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli fe mitipɛŋfoi pii yɛ mijakubii ateŋ, ni mihiɛ dɔ naakpa yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ he.
15 Shi be ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie mi eto kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni ekɛ edromɔ lɛ tsɛ mi kɛba lɛ hiɛ, 16 akɛ eeejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, koni mijaje ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mibiii gbɔmɔ ko ŋaawoo yɛ he, 17ni misaa miyaaa Yerusalɛm hu yɛ mɛi ni ji bɔfoi dani mi hu mitsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ miyiŋ kɛtee Arabia ni misaa miku misɛɛ kɛba Damasko ekoŋŋ. 18 Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii etɛ̃ lɛ, mitee Yerusalɛm ni mayale Kefa, ni mihi eŋɔɔ gbii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ; 19 shi minaaa bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko akɛ ja Yakobo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ. 20Shi nii ni miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, naa, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ mikɛɔ yɛ akɛ mimaleee.
21 No sɛɛ lɛ, miba Siria kɛ Kilikia niiaŋ. 22Shi aleee mihiɛ yɛ Yudea asafoi ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ amli; 23shi amɛnuɔ kɛkɛ akɛ akɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni be ko mli ni ewa wɔ yi lɛ, agbɛnɛ eejaje hemɔkɛyeli ni tsutsu lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã hiɛ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ.” 24Ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mihewɔ.

english_text:
1 Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus. 2But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
3Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised. 4We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves. 5But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
6 Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message. 7They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews. 8God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
9James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews. 10They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do.
Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
11When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong. 12He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles. 13He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled. 14But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said:
Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
15We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles. 16 But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
17When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't! 18But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first. 19It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God.
I have been nailed to the cross with Christ. 20I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me. 21I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_text:
Bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ŋɔ Paulo akɛ bɔfo
1 Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ misaa mikɛ Barnaba tee Yerusalɛm, ni miŋɔ Tito hu mifata mihe. 2Shi mitee yɛ kpojiemɔ ko naa, ni mikɛ Sanekpakpa ni mishiɛɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ yaŋmɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ sɔŋŋ ahiɛ bɔ ni afee ni foi ni midaa aloo ni mida lɛ akafee yaka. 3 Shi Tito tete ni kɛ mi yɔɔ ni eji Helanyo lɛ, anyɛɛɛ enɔ akɛ efo ketia. 4 Mɛi ni wo ketiafoo sane nɔ ji amale nyɛmimɛi komɛi ni ju shi kɛbafutu wɔ, ni amɛba nigii koni amɛbasara wɔhe ni wɔye yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, koni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ; 5 shi wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni wɔbo amɛ toi ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome po tete, koni Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ ahi shi daa ahã nyɛ.
6Shi mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ amɛyɔɔ gbɛi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa lɛ, jeee mihe sane ko ni, Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ehalaaa lɛ, mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi nɔ ko amɛfataaa he; 7 shi moŋ be ni amɛna akɛ atu foolɔi ateŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ jajemɔ lɛ awo midɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni atu ketiafolɔi anɔ lɛ awo Petro dɛŋ, 8ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsu nii yɛ Petro mli ni ehã eye bɔfo yɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etsu nii yɛ mi hu mimli yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, 9 be ni amɛyoo dromɔ ni akɛhã mi lɛ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, amɛkɛ naanyobɔɔ ninejurɔ lɛ ta mi kɛ Barnaba dɛ̃, koni wɔ lɛ wɔya jeŋmaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛ lɛ amɛya ketiafolɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ; 10 shi ohiafoi kɛkɛ amɛkɛɛ wɔkai, ni no nɔŋŋ he mɔdɛŋ mibɔ akɛ mafee.
11Shi be ni Kefa ba Antiokia lɛ midamɔ ehiɛ miku enaa, ejaakɛ eye sane ni ejaaa. 12 Ejaakɛ dani mɛi komɛi aaajɛ Yakobo ŋɔɔ aba lɛ, ekɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ yeɔ nii; shi be ni amɛba lɛ, egbala ehe shi ni etse ehe, ejaakɛ eeshe mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ gbeyei. 13Ni Yudafoi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛ lɛ fee nakai osato lɛ, ni amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ gbala Barnaba kɛtee amɛgbɛfaŋ. 14Shi be ni mina akɛ amɛnyiɛɛɛ trɔmɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛɛ Kefa yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ, “Kɛ bo ni oji Yudanyo lɛ ohiɔ shi tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋnyo ni jeee tamɔ Yudafonyo lɛ, mɛɛba onyɛɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhi shi tamɔ Yudafoi?”
Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ lɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ amɛyiwala
15Afɔ wɔ Yudafoi akɛ ni wɔjeee eshafeelɔi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli, 16 shi akɛni wɔle akɛ abuuu gbɔmɔ bem kɛjɛɛɛ Mla nitsumɔi amli, akɛ ja atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔhe Kristo Yesu nɔ wɔye, koni abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni jeee Mla nitsumɔi amli, ejaakɛ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem kɛjɛŋ Mla nitsumɔi amli. 17Shi agbɛnɛ kɛji wɔ ni wɔtaoɔ akɛ abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo mli lɛ ana wɔ akɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu eshafeelɔi ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ Kristo ji esha sɔ̃ɔlɔ lo? Dabida! 18Ejaakɛ kɛ nii ni mikumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mimaa ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ. 19 Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ migbo yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, koni mihiɛ akã ahã Nyɔŋmɔ. 20 Asɛŋ mi kɛ Kristo; hewɔ lɛ jeee mi mihiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, shi Kristo ni hiɛ kã yɛ mimli; shi mihiɛ ni kã yɛ heloo mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni sumɔ mi ni ekɛ ehe hã yɛ mihewɔ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli mihiɛ kã yɛ. 21Mikwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla nɔ jalɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, belɛ Kristo lɛ yakatswaa egbo lɛ.

english_text:
Faith Is the Only Way
1You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you? 2I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him? 3How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you? 4Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing? 5God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
6 The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith. 7 And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham. 8 Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him. 9This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
10 Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.” 11 No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
12 The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands. 13 But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse. 14And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit.
The Law and the Promise
15My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement. 16That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ. 17 What I am saying is that the Law cannot change or cancel God's promise made 430 years before the Law was given. 18 If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
19What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people. 20There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him.
Slaves and Children
21Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law. 22But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
23The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith. 24In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God. 25But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
26All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus. 27And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes. 28Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman. 29 So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_text:
Mla loo hemɔkɛyeli
1O Galatiabii ni bɛ yitsoŋ! Namɔ kpɛ nyɛ ayɛ, nyɛ ni atɛŋ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ? 2Enɛ kɛkɛ mitaoɔ male yɛ nyɛnaa: Mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi amli nyɛna kɛjɛ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi mli? 3Aso nɛkɛ nyɛbɛ yitsoŋ? Ni nyɛkɛ mumɔ bɔ̃i lɛ, agbɛnɛ heloo nyɛkɛbaagbe naa lo? 4Nɔ babaoo ni nyɛna nɛɛ, yakatswaa nyɛna lo (kɛ eyɛ mli akɛ yakatswaa nyɛna lɛ)? 5Belɛ mɔ ni kɛ Mumɔ lɛ hãa nyɛ ni etsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi ahewɔ efeɔ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛboɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ hewɔ ni? 6 Tamɔ bɔ ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.
7No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, amɛ ji Abrahambii. 8 Shi akɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ ena momo akɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu jeŋmaji lɛ abem yɛ hewɔ lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham eto akɛ, “Omli aaajɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ.” 9 Belɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ Abraham heyelɔ lɛ.
10 Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ Mla nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ, loomɔ kã amɛnɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eyaaa nɔ efeee nii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ.” 11 Shi eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla mli lɛ abuŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bem yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ “jalɔ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli mli eyi aaana wala yɛ;” 12 shi Mla lɛ, jeee hemɔkɛyeli sane ni, shi moŋ “Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.”
13 Kristo kpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ Mla lɛ loomɔ lɛ mli, akɛni etsɔ̃ loomɔ ehã wɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ;” 14koni Abraham jɔɔmɔ lɛ aba jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli, ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli ana Mumɔ ni awo he shi lɛ.
Mla lɛ kɛ shiwoo lɛ
15Anyɛmimɛi, miiwie lɛ gbɔmɛiaŋ: gbɔmɔ kpãŋmɔ tete, kɛji akpɛlɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwaaa, ni asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fataaa he. 16 Shi Abraham lɛ, akɛ lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ wie shiwoo wiemɔi lɛ. Ekɛɛɛ akɛ, “kɛ oshwiei lɛ” tamɔ nɔ ni ekɛ mɛi pii miiwie, shi moŋ tamɔ mɔ kome akɛ, “kɛ oshwie lɛ”, mɔ ni ji Kristo lɛ. 17 Shi nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ji akɛ Mla ni awo yɛ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eguuu kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ema nɔ aduatsɔ eto lɛ ni ehã shiwoo lɛ afee yaka. 18Shi kɛ gboshinii lɛ jɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ jeee shiwoo lɛ mli ejɛ dɔŋŋ; shi Abraham lɛ, shiwoo nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛke lɛ.
19 Agbɛnɛ mɛɛ ji Mla lɛ mɔ? Akɛhã ni akɛna nɔtɔmɔi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni shwie ni awo lɛ shi lɛ aaaba; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ atsɔ̃ awo Mla lɛ, ni akɛwo mlidaamɔlɔ dɛŋ. 20Shi mlidaamɔlɔ sane lɛ, ejeee mɔ kome nɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ kome ji lɛ.
21 Agbɛnɛ Mla lɛ shiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi lɛ lo? Dabida! Ejaakɛ eji awo mla ko ni aaanyɛ wala ahã kulɛ, anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔbembuu baajɛ mla nɔyeli mli. 22 Shi moŋ; ŋmalɛ lɛ eŋa nibii fɛɛ yi ewo esha shishi, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛ shiwoo lɛ ahã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ehã wɔye wɔhe
23Shi dani hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ba lɛ, aŋa wɔyi tamɔ gboklɛfoi awo Mla shishi kɛyashi hemɔkɛyeli ni abaajie kpo lɛ aaaba. 24No hewɔ lɛ, Mla lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔtsɔselɔ kɛmiiya Kristo ŋɔɔ koni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem. 25 Shi ni hemɔkɛyeli ba nɛɛ, wɔbɛ tsɔselɔ lɛ shishi dɔŋŋ. 26 Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ; 27 ejaakɛ nyɛ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi nyɛ awo Kristo mli lɛ, nyɛwo Kristo. 28 Yudanyo bɛ lɛ, Helanyo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɔŋ bɛ lɛ, odehe hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nuu bɛ lɛ, yoo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ: ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli. 29 Shi kɛji Kristo nii ji nyɛ lɛ, belɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ, kɛ gboshiniiyelɔi hu yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa.

english_text:
1Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs. 2This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set. 3This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
4But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law, 5 so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children. 6 Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father. 7You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised.
Paul's Concern for the Galatians
8Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real. 9But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers? 10You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years. 11I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
12My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me 13when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick. 14My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself. 15Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me. 16Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
17Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention. 18It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you. 19My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you. 20I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled.
Hagar and Sarah
21Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says? 22 In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free. 23The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
24All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave. 25Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
26 But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave. 27 The Scriptures say about her,
“You have never had children,
but now you can be glad.
You have never given birth,
but now you can shout.
Once you had no children,
but now you will have
more children than a woman
who has been married
for a long time.”
28My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was. 29 But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today. 30 The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.” 31My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_text:
1Shi miikɛɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni gboshiniiyelɔ lɛ ji abifao lɛ, srɔto ko bɛ ekɛ nyɔŋ teŋ, tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji nii lɛ fɛɛ tsɛ; 2shi moŋ eyɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsuji nukpai ashishi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni tsɛ lɛ eto lɛ. 3 Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu, be ni wɔji abifabii lɛ, akɛ wɔ wo je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anyɔŋyeli lɛ shishi. 4 Shi be ni be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kɛba, yoo fɔ lɛ, eba Mla shishi; 5 koni ebakpɔ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ bii. 6 Shi akɛni bii ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu eBi lɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛba nyɛtsuii amli, ni eboɔ akɛ, “Aba, Ataa!” 7 No hewɔ lɛ, ojeee nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ bi ji bo, ni kɛji bi ji bo lɛ, belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ efee bo niyelɔ hu.
Galatiabii asɛɛsɛɛyaa
8Shi be mli ni nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛfee nyɛhe nyɔji nyɛhã nibii ni yɛ amɛbɔɔsu naa lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ni lɛ; 9shi agbɛnɛ moŋ ni nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ele nyɛ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkuɔ nyɛsɛɛ kɛya shishijee nibii ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ko afee ni bɛ hewalɛ ko lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛje shishi nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ? 10 Nyɛyeɔ gbii kɛ nyɔji kɛ bei kɛ afii ahe gbɛjianɔ ni ato lɛ nɔ. 11 Miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ yakatswaa migba mihe naa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ.
12 Miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtamɔa mi, ejaakɛ mi hu mitamɔ nyɛ. Nyɛfeko mi efɔŋ ko; 13 shi nyɛle akɛ heloo gbedemɔ mli mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mijaje lɛ, 14ni nɔ ni ji naatsɔ̃ɔmɔ hã nyɛ yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛgbeee he guɔ ni asaŋ nyɛnyaŋeee; shi moŋ nyɛhere mi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, tamɔ Kristo Yesu diɛŋtsɛ. 15Agbɛnɛ nɛgbɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ miiye nyɛhe odase akɛ ehiɔ feemɔ jikulɛ nyɛfamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii tete nyɛhã mi. 16 Ani mitsɔ̃ nyɛhenyɛlɔ akɛ mikɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale lɛ? 17 Jeee nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ kpakpa ko mɛi komɛi bɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao akɛ amɛtsi nyɛ wɔŋɔɔbaa gbɛ moŋ, koni nyɛbɔ amɛ moŋ amɛhe mɔdɛŋ. 18Shi ehi akɛ abɔ nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ daa kɛji akɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa fee, ni jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ. 19 Mibii bibii ni mikɔ̃mɔɔ kɛ nyɛfɔmɔ ekoŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaashɔ̃ Kristo subaŋ yɛ nyɛmli. 20Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ nyɛmasɛi amrɔ nɛɛ ni mitsake gbɛ nɔ ni matsɔ̃ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie, ejaakɛ miyiŋ feɔ mi kɔshikɔshi yɛ nyɛhewɔ!
Mla lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ
21 Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhi Mla shishi lɛ, nyɛkɛa mi, ani nyɛnuuu Mla lɛ lo? 22 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ Abraham yɛ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome lɛ, ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ. 23 Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa; shi mɔ ni ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ shiwoo naa. 24 Nibii nɛɛ abɛ ni. Enɛɛmɛi ji kpãŋmɔi enyɔ lɛ. Ekome lɛ jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋyeli mli efɔɔ ewoɔ: no ji Hagar; 25ejaakɛ Hagar ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ Arabia; shi ekɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ekɛ ebii lɛ ji nyɔji; 26 shi ŋwɛi Yerusalɛm lɛ ji odehe lɛ, ni ji wɔnyɛ lɛ. 27 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ,
“La nyamɔ lala, bo kene ni ofɔɔɔ;
wo nyamɔ nɔ ni obolɔ kɛ miishɛɛ,
bo ni okɔ̃mɔɔɔ;
ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ moŋ bii fa
fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ po!”
28 Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔ lɛ, shiwoo lɛ bii ji wɔ tamɔ Isak. 29 Shi tamɔ bɔ ni no be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa lɛ waa mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ yi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ hu. 30 Shi mɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ? “Shwiemɔ nyɔŋyoo lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɔŋyoo bi lɛ ekɛ odehe lɛ bi lɛ yeŋ gboshinii lɛ.” 31 No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔjeee nyɔŋyoo lɛ bii, shi moŋ odehe lɛ bii.

english_text:
Christ Gives Freedom
1Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
2I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised. 3If you do, you must obey the whole Law. 4And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace. 5But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ. 6If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
7You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth. 8And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you. 9 A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough, 10but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
11My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised. 12I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
13My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love. 14 All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself. 15But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves.
God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
16If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires. 17 The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should. 18But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
19People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds. 20They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are 21envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
22God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful, 23gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways. 24And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires. 25God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit. 26But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_text:
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛheyeli lɛ mli
1 Kristo ehã wɔye wɔhe, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ni nyɛkahãa abɔa nyɛ nyɔŋyeli apã lɛ dɔŋŋ. 2 Naa, mi Paulo, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛhã afolɔ nyɛ ketia lɛ, Kristo he baŋ sɛɛnamɔ haŋ nyɛ. 3Shi misaa miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni foɔ ketia lɛ akɛ ehiɛ nyɔmɔ, no ji akɛ eye Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. 4Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ abu nyɛ bem yɛ Mla mli lɛ, nyɛtse nyɛhe kɛjɛ Kristo he; nyɛjɛ dromɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi. 5Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɛɔ jalɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ. 6 Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, jeee ketiafoo, ni asaŋ jeee foo hu ni nyɛɔ nɔ ko efeɔ, shi moŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni tsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ nɔ etsuɔ nii lɛ.
7Kulɛ nyɛmiiya nɔ jogbaŋŋ; namɔ po tsi nyɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛkabo anɔkwale lɛ toi? 8 Jwɛŋmɔ tsake mɔ nɛɛ, jeee mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ mli ejɛ. 9 Masha bibioo hãa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ shaa. 10 Mi lɛ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ ebaŋ lɛ akɛ nyɛaajwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ kroko; shi mɔ ni haoɔ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji lɛ, esɔ̃ abua eyiteŋ. 11 Shi mi lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji ketiafoo lɛ mishiɛɔ lolo lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni awaa mi yi lolo? Nakai ni kulɛ, sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he pampi lɛ sɛɛ efo. 12 Ao mina ni kulɛ mɛi ni hãa nyɛgbugbãa lɛ folɔ amɛhenii tete po amɛshwie.
Heyeli mli shihilɛ kɛ Mumɔ naa nyiɛmɔ
13 Ejaakɛ heyeli mli atsɛ nyɛ kɛba, anyɛmimɛi; shi nyɛheyeli lɛ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkahãa etsɔ̃a hegbɛ ehã heloo lɛ taomɔnii, shi moŋ nyɛtsɔa suɔmɔ nɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe. 14 Ejaakɛ Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli yɛ wiemɔ kome nɛɛ mli akɛ, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.” 15Shi kɛ nyɛkɔ̃mɔkɔ̃mɔɔ nyɛhe ni nyɛyeyeɔ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakpãtãa nyɛhe hiɛ.
16 Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji, “Nyɛnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ naa, ni nyɛfeŋ heloo akɔnɔi lɛ anaa nii.” 17 Ejaakɛ nii ni heloo lɛ taoɔ lɛ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ eyaaa, ni nii ni Mumɔ lɛ hu taoɔ lɛ kɛ heloo lɛ eyaaa; enɛɛmɛi kɛ amɛhe yeee, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nii ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ nyɛfee. 18Shi kɛ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbɛ Mla lɛ shishi.
19 Shi heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ: nomɛi ji ajwamãŋbɔɔ, mujinitsumɔ, nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, 20wɔŋjamɔ, suu, nyɛɛ, bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, bei mumɔ, atuatsemɔ, mligbalamɔ, 21 hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, dãatɔɔ, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ nii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi, nii ni miikɛɛ nyɛ mato, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ momo lɛ, akɛ mɛi ni feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛnine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
22Shi Mumɔ lɛ yibii ji suɔmɔ, miishɛɛ, hejɔlɛ, tsuishitoo, mlihilɛ, ejurɔfeemɔ, hemɔkɛyeli, 23 kpoofeemɔ, henɔyeli.
