1 Ni mina ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee; ejaakɛ tsutsu ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ tsutsu shikpɔŋ lɛ eho etee, ni ŋshɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ. 2 Ni mina Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm hee lɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi miikpeleke shi, ni asaa lɛ ato tamɔ ayɛmforo ni awula lɛ ahã ewu. 3 Ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni eeehi shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ emaŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛ aaahi shi. 4 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yafonui fɛɛ. Gbele bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋkɔmɔyeli loo bolɔmɔ loo nɔnaa ko hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ tsutsunii lɛ eho etee.”
5 Ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Naa, miifee nii fɛɛ ehee.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa, ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli.” 6 Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbe naa. Mi ji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ. Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, mahã lɛ wala nubu lɛ mli nu lɛ eko yaka. 7 Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yelɔ, ni matsɔ eNyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mibi. 8 Shi gbeyelɔi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi kɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi kɛ sulɔi kɛ wɔŋjalɔi kɛ amalelɔi fɛɛ lɛ, amɛna amɛgbɛhe yɛ kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ la kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli. Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ.”
Yerusalɛm Hee lɛ
9 Ni bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ naagbee haomɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba miŋɔɔ ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, “Ba, ni matsɔ̃ bo ayɛmforo lɛ ni ji Toobi lɛ ŋa lɛ.” 10 Ni eŋɔ mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee gɔŋ kpele ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi maŋ kpeteŋkple ni ji Yerusalɛm krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi eekpleke shi, 11 ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ni ekpɛɔ tamɔ tɛ ni jara wa waa, tamɔ yaspi ni mli tse akɛ kristalo. 12 Eyɛ gbogbo kpeteŋkple ni kwɔ kɛ agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ damɔ agboi lɛ anaa, ni aŋmala gbɛii ni ji Israelbii lɛ akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ nɔ. 13Agboi etɛ̃ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ anaigbɛ. 14Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ yɛ shishitoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni Toobi lɛ bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛnɔ.
15 Ni bɔfo ni kɛ mi wie lɛ hiɛ shika susumɔtso koni ekɛsusu maŋ lɛ kɛ egboi lɛ kɛ egbogbo lɛ. 16 Ni maŋ lɛ kã shi koji ejwɛ, ni ekɛlɛ tamɔ elɛɛmɔ nɔŋŋ. Ni ekɛ susumɔtso lɛ susu maŋ lɛ, ni efee shitoi akpe kome kɛ ohai enumɔ. Ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ kɛ ekwɔlɛ ye egbɔ. 17Ni esusu egbogbo lɛ efee ninetalɔi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ nisusumɔtso naa, ni ji bɔfo lɛ tso lɛ. 18Ni nɔ ni akɛtswa gbogbo lɛ ji yaspi, ni maŋ lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tamɔ ashwishwɛ krɔŋŋ ni. 19 Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ shishitoo lɛ awula amɛ kɛ tɛi ni jara wa srɔtoi fɛɛ. Klɛŋklɛŋ shishitoo lɛ yaspi, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ safiro, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kalkedɔn, nɔ ni ji ejwɛ smaragdo, 20nɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ sardonike, nɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ sardio, nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ krisolito, nɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ berilo, nɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ topasiɔn, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ krisopraso, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ hiakinto, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ amɛtisto. 21 Ni agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ adiagbai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni, agbo kome lɛ adiagba kome akɛfee. Ni maŋ lɛ blohu lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni, ni emli tse tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
22Ni minaaa Sɔlemɔtsu yɛ mli, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ ji eSɔlemɔtsu. 23 Ni hulu loo nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛmɔ he ehĩaaa maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ mli, ni Toobi lɛ ji ela. 24 Ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaanyiɛ yɛ ela lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaaŋɔ amɛnunyam lɛ kɛaaba mli. 25 Ni egboi lɛ aŋamɔŋ kwraa shwane, ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi. 26Ni akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anunyam lɛ kɛ amɛwoo lɛ aaaba mli. 27 Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ mɔ ni maleɔ boteŋ mli kwraa akɛ ja mɛi ni aŋma amɛgbɛi yɛ Toobi lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.

english_text:
1 The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated. 2 Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
3 God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God 4 and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people. 5 Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever.
The Coming of Christ
6Then I was told:
These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon. 7Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
8My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
9But the angel said,
Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
10Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
11 Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
12 Then I was told:
I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done. 13 I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
14 God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city. 15But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
16 I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
17 The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!”
Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!”
If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
18 Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book:
If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book. 19If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
20The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!”
So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
21I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_text:
Walanu Faa lɛ kɛ Walatso lɛ
1 Ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi walanu faa ni hiɛ kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ kristalo ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli. 2 Ni eblohu lɛ teŋ kɛ faa lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ walatso ma shi, ni ewoɔ yibii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ekome nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ, ni tso lɛ yibai lɛ akɛtsaa jeŋmaji lɛ. 3 Ni musu ko musu ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ aaama maŋ lɛ mli; ni etsuji lɛ aaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ; 4 ni amɛaana ehiɛ, ni egbɛi lɛ aaahi amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ. 5 Ni nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi, ni kane la loo hulu la he ehiaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatso ahã amɛ, ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Yesu baa ni ji enyɔ lɛ
6 Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli. Ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ni sa akɛ aba nɔŋŋ.”
7 “Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.”
8 Ni mi, Yohane, ji mɔ ni nu ni na nii nɛɛ. Ni be ni minu ni mina lɛ miho mibu shi ni maja yɛ bɔfo lɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii nɛɛ lɛ naji anaa. 9Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, kaafee nakai! Ejaakɛ bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi. Já Nyɔŋmɔ!” 10 Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaasɔo nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. 11Mɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, eya nɔ efee nii ni ejaaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji mujiatsɛ lɛ, eya nɔ ewo ehe muji lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji jalɔ lɛ, eya nɔ efee jalɛnii, ni mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eya nɔ ehi krɔŋkrɔŋ.”
12 “Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mihiɛ minyɔmɔwo lɛ kɛmiiba, ni mawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔ lɛ. 13 Mi ji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ.”
14Ajɔɔ mɛi ni fɔɔ amɛtadei lɛ ahe, koni amɛna hegbɛ yɛ walatso lɛ he ní amɛtsɔ̃ agboi lɛ amli kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. 15 Shi maŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbei lɛ kɛ sulɔi lɛ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi lɛ kɛ amãgãjalɔi lɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ amale ni emaleɔ yɔɔ jɛi.
16 “Mi Yesu, mitsu mibɔfo lɛ koni ebaye nii nɛɛ ahe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ amli. Mi ji David shishifã lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ, tooloo ni kpɛɔ lɛ.”
17 Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛ Ayɛmforo lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Ba!” Ni mɔ ni nuɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ba!” Ni mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, eba, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ lɛ, ebahe wala nu lɛ yaka.
Naagbee
18 Mi miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fata nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ haomɔi ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ afata he ahã lɛ. 19 Ni kɛji mɔ ko jie nɔ ko kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbalɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie egbɛnaa kɛaajɛ wala wolo lɛ kɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nii ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ amli.
20Mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ he odase lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hɛɛ, miiba nɔŋŋ!’ ” Amen! Ba, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu!
21WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen!
